name: Normephedrone
summary: 4-Methylcathinone (4-MC), also known as normephedrone, is a stimulant drug of the cathinone group. It is an active metabolite of the better known drug mephedrone (4-methylmethcathinone or 4-MMC).

pharmacology.text: It is an active metabolite of the better known drug mephedrone (4-methylmethcathinone or 4-MMC). 4-MC is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA) similarly to mephedrone.
